title: High-dimensional statistics for biomedical data
description: Statistical machine learning techniques and advanced mathematical concepts for analysis of high-dimensional biomedical data. Topics include optimal transport and probabilistic modeling for multi-modal genomic and imaging data integration and analysis of spatial and temporal dynamics. Programming assignments, problem sets, and a final project will be required.
prerequisites_text: Prerequisites: ( APMA E2000 and COMS W4771 and MATH UN2010 ) or ( APMA E2101 ) Strong background in Python (or R) programming- Background in probability/statistics is recommended.
